groups.name: Rounded corners on cards and containers
groups.definition: Do cards, images and containers use moderately to generously rounded corners (roughly 6–16px radii) rather than square corners?

groups.name: Square corners everywhere
groups.definition: Are all elements square-cornered with no rounded corners, pills or circles?

groups.name: Soft shadowed white cards
groups.definition: Are cards white or cream, rounded, with soft diffuse shadows and generous padding?

groups.name: Shadow only on hero image
groups.definition: Is a soft shadow applied sparingly, limited to the hero image or card and a few key images?

groups.name: Flat design without shadows or gradients
groups.definition: Is the styling flat, with no box shadows, gradients, or animations?

groups.name: More shadows and transforms for depth
groups.definition: Do surfaces use many box shadows and transforms to create depth?

groups.name: Gradient hero background
groups.definition: Does the hero have a gradient or glow background?

groups.name: Dark overlay on photo backgrounds
groups.definition: Is a dimmed or tinted overlay placed over a photo background with white text on top?

groups.name: Alternating background bands between sections
groups.definition: Are sections separated by alternating solid or tinted background color bands?

groups.name: Thin borders and hairline separators
groups.definition: Are content and sections separated by thin borders, rules or hairlines rather than hr dividers?

groups.name: Accent bar or rule on headings and quotes
groups.definition: Are there short accent-colored underline bars or left rules on headings or pull quotes?

groups.name: Decorative background graphic in hero
groups.definition: Does the hero include a faded decorative graphic such as stripes behind the headline?

groups.name: Text glyph icons without SVG or icon fonts
groups.definition: Are icons absent or text-based, with no SVG or icon fonts?
